limitations: No source-general qualification or publication claim.
Suite-declared test counters are retained separately from testcase records and sdist collection.
Process-death recovery does not establish physical power-cut survival.
Hosted checkout source seals account for LF/CRLF; later release reuse requires exact Git blobs, modes and paths.

source_representation_note: Windows checkout CRLF hashes and exact immutable Git blob hashes are retained separately; release reuse requires exact Git path/mode/blob/ancestry proof.

review_limits: Artifact ZIP and extracted member bytes verified against source-bound GitHub metadata.
Published numerical projections checked for internal arithmetic, accounting, planned coverage, source bindings and histogram consistency; raw private worker rows are not retained in these ZIPs.
One serial pass; no repeatability estimate. Instrumented diagnostic excluded from headline rates.
Stage wall times overlap; no additive critical-path or percentage attribution. Calling-thread CPU excludes native ONNX threads; phase attribution is approximate.

Profile failed spans measure wrapped attempts, including background acquisition deferrals; they do not establish failed user operations. User accounting shows no failed acknowledgements or unknown outcomes.
Functional twelve-anchor retrieval checks do not establish held-out retrieval or competitor superiority.

later_release_requirements: Later release source needs current CI and primary/floor qualification; measured storage/test-speed reuse requires exact Git paths, modes, blob IDs and ancestry.
